metadata.case_name: CHOI MEI HO v. CHUNG CHIU YING T/A KIN KEE AND OTHERS

injuries.description: Radiologically revealed a fractured dislocation of the 12 thoracic vertebra over the 1st lumbar vertebra.
source: Radiologically revealed a fractured dislocation of the 12 thoracic vertebra over the 1st lumbar vertebra.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified fracture of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: The spinal cord was found to be crushed by the bony injury at the site of dislocation. She remained complete paraplegic.
injuries.body_part: spinal cord at T12/L1; lower spinal cord
source: The spinal cord was found to be crushed by the bony injury at the site of dislocation.
She is a complete paraplegia with complete loss of sensation from waist down and paralysis of the lower extremities. She is wheelchair-bound. Her deficits are permanent.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of lumbar spinal cord

injuries.description: One laceration over right parietal region of head.
source: One laceration over right parietal region of head.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Bruises over right forehead, right thigh, left shoulder and upper back.
injuries.body_part: right forehead; right thigh; left shoulder; upper back
source: Bruises over right forehead, right thigh, left shoulder and upper back.

manifestations.description: Loss of sensation from lower abdomen (at level of iliac crest) downwards involving both lower limbs.
Loss of muscular movement in both lower limbs.

She has to empty her bladder every 3 to 4 hours by intermittent self catheterization. She has no anrectal sensation and rectal suppositories are needed every few days for her bowel movements. Faecal soiling may still occur.
Intermittent painful paresthesia in the proximal segment of both lower limbs, particularly around the groins and the hips.
Marked angulation of lower thoracic spine with tenderness.
Wheelchair-bound; needs assistance in getting upright as well as transferring from wheelchair to bed and vice versa; needs 24 hour care and attention.
She suffers from total loss of sexual function.

Depression: depressive mood and associated symptoms such as loss of interest, energy and initiative, loss of self esteem, insomnia, poor appetite and impaired congitive functioning; condition moderate to severe in degree.
The Plaintiff's life expectancy has been substantially reduced because of her impairments.

treatments_received.treatment: Luque instrumentation to stabilize the reduced spine (operation performed 25th December 1988).
source: An operation was performed on 25th December 1988. Luque instrumentation was carried out to stabilize the reduced spine.

treatments_received.treatment: Removal of Luque implant (operation performed 6th February 1990).
source: Further operation was carried out on 6th February 1990 to remove the Luque implant and clinical examination revealed no change of her neurological impairment.

treatments_received.treatment: Intermittent self catheterization (empty bladder every 3 to 4 hours).
source: She has to empty her bladder every 3 to 4 hours by intermittent self catheterization.

treatments_future.treatment: Physiotherapy: 40 sessions for first 20 weeks and thereafter biweekly on maintenance basis at $80 per session.
source: David Siu, physiotherapist, ... recommends 40 sessions for the first 20 weeks and thereafter biweekly on maintenance basis. The charges are $80 per session. The total is $40,640. I make an award in this sum.

treatments_future.treatment: Occupational therapy: attendance twice a week for the first three months.
source: Alice Tsang recommends attendance at her clinic by the Plaintiff twice a week for the first three months ... I allow her claim for the cost of occupational therapy at $800 per attendance twice a week for three months i.e. $19,200.

treatments_future.treatment: Psychiatric treatment: counselling and antidepressant medication (two years at higher cost then three years maintenance).
source: The cost for treatment and medication will be $40,000 per year for the first two years and thereafter $20,000 each year for maintenance for three years. ... The award is $40,000 x 2 for the first two years and $20,000 x 3 for the three years that follow, making a total of $140,000.

treatments_future.treatment: Nursing care/nurse visits (reduced award to half of claimed nursing massage hours).
source: The claim for nursing care in this respect should be reduced to half.

treatments_future.treatment: Engagement of a full time maid (sleep-in) and relief staff.
source: Full time maid ... $1,000 per month x 12 x 12 ... Relief staff $2,000 per year x 12

treatments_future.treatment: Regular medical check ups and yearly tests.
source: Dr Woo recommends 6 monthly medical check ups and yearly tests such as X'ray, blood and urine tests. The cost will be $2,000 per year. I accept this is necessary and reasonable. The award is $2,000 x 12 = $24,000.

treatments_future.treatment: Hospitalisation provision (future contingency for pressure sores etc.).
source: The cost at $4,000 per year is also accepted. This is a provision for the Plaintiff in the later years of her life when pressure sores may develop and require treatment and hospitalisation. The award is $4,000 x 12 = $48,000.

losses.description: She needs assistance in getting upright as well as transferring from wheelchair to bed and vice versa. She needs 24 hour care and attention.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: She suffers from total loss of sexual function.
She suffers from depression with impaired congitive functioning; condition moderate to severe in degree.
The Plaintiff's life expectancy has been substantially reduced because of her impairments.
All the doctors who examined the Plaintiff assessed her loss of earning capacity to be 100%. The Plaintiff is not able to work and cannot be expected to do so.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Injuries to T12 and L1 rendering paraplegics paralysed from waist down with total loss of sensation; constant pain in lower limbs and psychiatric problems.
